raw.query: WITH cell_wape AS (SELECT resolution, variate, model, AVG(wape) AS avg_wape FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE candidate='point' AND mode='uni' GROUP BY resolution, variate, model) SELECT resolution, variate, MIN(CASE WHEN model='chronos' THEN avg_wape END) AS chronos, MIN(CASE WHEN model='timesfm' THEN avg_wape END) AS timesfm, MIN(CASE WHEN model='toto' THEN avg_wape END) AS toto, MIN(CASE WHEN model='ewma' THEN avg_wape END) AS ewma, MIN(CASE WHEN model='holt_winters' THEN avg_wape END) AS hw, MIN(CASE WHEN model='naive' THEN avg_wape END) AS naive, CASE WHEN chronos<ewma AND chronos<hw AND chronos<naive AND timesfm<ewma AND timesfm<hw AND timesfm<naive AND toto<ewma AND toto<hw AND toto<naive THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS claim_check FROM cell_wape GROUP BY resolution, variate ORDER BY resolution, variate;
raw.observed: In 19/20 (resolution, signal) cells all three FM (chronos/timesfm/toto) beat all three baselines (ewma/holt_winters/naive); in cell (45s, requests) chronos WAPE=0.3897 loses to ewma WAPE=0.3893 (Δ=+0.0004), so claim_check=FAIL.
raw.evidence: Forecast_metrics has exactly 3 FM (chronos,timesfm,toto) and 3 fixed-param baselines (ewma,holt_winters,naive) over 20 (resolution,variate) cells in uni mode; chronos is not strictly better than ewma at (45s, requests), breaking the 'in all twenty cells' universal.
